summary: Syrak Micael, a nonpartisan candidate for Berkeley's District 7 City Council seat, holds a full general-election endorsement from CAIR Action and an Ally designation from Vote for Peace. Both organizations evaluate candidates on Gaza and civil-rights positions, and their directional recommendations function here as concrete evidence of the candidate's stance on Palestinian justice.
